products.title: Products
products.intro: Add a new product or change an old one. A product goes on the shop only when its checklist is complete.
products.emptyAll: No products yet — add the first one.

kpi.needPhotosSub: fewer than {n}, or a kind missing

search.label: Search products
search.placeholder: Search name, SKU, category or colour

bulk.label: Change the selected products
bulk.confirmArchive: Archive {n} products? They leave the list. Nothing is deleted and you can restore them.
bulk.someDone: {done} done, {failed} not done — see the list above.
bulk.tooMany: At most {max} products in one go.

edit.intro: Change what you need and press "Save changes". The shop changes only for a product that is on it.

new.title: New product
new.intro: Start with the name, category and fabric. Colours, sizes, prices and photos come next, on the product's own page.
new.sub: The product starts as a draft: it is not on the shop yet.
new.created: Created — now add colours, sizes and photos.
new.note: Nothing goes on the shop from here.
new.readyNote: After you create it, this card shows what is still missing before it can go on the shop.

sections.namingSub: Leave a field empty to use the shop's template. A changed link forwards the old one by itself.
sections.coloursSub: {n} on this product, in the order the shop shows them
sections.sizesSub: Pick the sizes; each colour gets a box per size below. Taking a size off retires its SKUs — kept, never deleted.
sections.variantsSub: One box per colour and size

fields.nameHelp: Customers read this name on cards, the product page and the bag.
fields.styleHelp: The ERP's code for this style; suggested SKUs start with it.
fields.sizeChartNone: None yet — set it on the size charts page.
fields.templateHint: Empty = the shop's template (shown in grey).

colours.added: {name} added to the colour library and this product.
colours.similar: {name} added — it looks close to {other}; check it is not the same colour.

variants.filled: {n} SKUs filled in — check them against the ERP.
variants.nothingToFill: Every new box already has a SKU.
variants.needStyle: Type the style code first; the suggestion starts with it.
variants.pricesLocked: Only people allowed to set prices can change them.
variants.none: Add a colour and pick sizes to make SKUs.
variants.note: Stock comes from the ERP; it is shown here, not typed. A box without a SKU is not made. Prices are typed in whole units.

photos.confirmOff: Take this photo off the product? It stays in the media library.
photos.removed: Photo taken off; it stays in the library.
photos.noRead: You cannot see the media library; ask the owner.
photos.noUpload: You can see the photos but not add them.

publish.confirmOff: Take this product off the shop? Its page and everything else stay.
publish.confirmArchive: Archive this product? Nothing is deleted and you can restore it.
publish.published: It is on the shop now.
publish.readyNote: The checklist is complete: it can go on the shop.
publish.blockedNote: It can go on the shop when every "must" item below is done.
publish.liveNote: Customers can see and buy it.
publish.liveFailing: It is on the shop but something is missing now — see below.
publish.archivedNote: Archived: not on the shop and not in the list.
publish.noPermission: You cannot put products on the shop; ask the owner.

ready.note: Reminders do not stop publishing; "must" items do.

save.note: Changes are saved only when you press Save.
save.dirty: You have changes that are not saved.

errors.CONFLICT: This cannot be done in its current state.
errors.NOT_FOUND: It was not found; it may have been changed meanwhile.
errors.SKU_TAKEN: This SKU is already used by another product: {fields}
errors.SKU_RETIRED: This SKU belonged to a retired garment and is never reused: {fields}
errors.SKU_FORMAT: This SKU does not match the shop's SKU pattern: {fields}
errors.VARIANT_EXISTS: There is already a SKU for this colour and size.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This link is used elsewhere; choose another.
errors.SLUG_RESERVED: This link is reserved; choose another.
errors.COLOUR_IN_USE: This colour still has SKUs on sale; take its sizes off first.
errors.NAME_TAKEN: That colour name is already in the library.
errors.UNKNOWN_KEY: A value is not in its list: {fields}
errors.PARENT_ARCHIVED: The category or fabric is archived.
errors.TOO_MANY_CHANGES: Too many products in one go.
errors.NOT_AN_IMAGE: This file is not a photo.
errors.TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This kind of file is not allowed.
errors.TOO_SMALL: The photo is too small for the shop.
errors.ARCHIVED: This file is archived; restore it first.

variants.label: Colours & sizes
variants.none: Add a colour and a size with its SKU.

sizeChart.label: Size chart
sizeChart.none: No size chart for this product or its category.

seo.label: Google title & description
seo.none: Fill in the Google title and description.

stock.label: Stock
stock.none: No stock yet (it comes from the ERP).

sellableStock.label: Stock where the shop sells from
sellableStock.none: The ERP shows no piece in a place the shop sells from.

queue.title: Ready to publish
queue.intro: Every product that is not on the shop waits here until its checklist is complete. Publish the ready ones; open the others to finish them.

filters.label: Show
filters.live: On the shop, needs a fix {n}

reason.live-failing: On the shop · needs a fix
